Solar Farm.name: Solar Farm
Solar Farm.description: Place this tile which grants an ADJACENCY BONUS of 2 energy. Increase your energy production 1 step for each plant resource on the area where you place the tile.

Mare Nectaris Mine.name: Mare Nectaris Mine
Mare Nectaris Mine.description: Spend 1 titanium. Increase your steel production 1 step. Place a mine ON THE RESERVED AREA and raise the mining rate 1 step.

Mare Nubium Mine.name: Mare Nubium Mine
Mare Nubium Mine.description: Spend 1 titanium. Increase your titanium production 1 step. Place a mine ON THE RESERVED AREA and raise the mining rate 1 step.

Mare Imbrium Mine.name: Mare Imbrium Mine
Mare Imbrium Mine.description: Spend 1 titanium. Increase your steel production 1 step and your titanium production 1 step. Place a mine ON THE RESERVED AREA and raise the mining rate 1 step.

Mare Serenitatis Mine.name: Mare Serenitatis Mine
Mare Serenitatis Mine.description: Spend 2 titanium and 1 steel. Increase your steel and titanium production 1 step. Place a mine ON THE RESERVED AREA and a road tile adjacent to it. Raise the mining rate 1 step and the logistic rate 1 step.

Habitat 14.name: Habitat 14
Habitat 14.description: Decrease your energy production 1 step and your M€ production 1 step. Spend 1 titanium. Place a habitat tile on The Moon and raise the habitat rate 1 step.

Geodesic Tents.name: Geodesic Tents
Geodesic Tents.description: Decrease your energy production 1 step and increase your plant production 1 step. Spend 1 titanium. Place a habitat tile on The Moon and raise the habitat rate 1 step.

Sphere Habitats.name: Sphere Habitats
Sphere Habitats.description: Spend 1 titanium. Place a habitat tile on The Moon and raise the habitat rate 1 step.

The Womb.name: The Womb
The Womb.description: Decrease your energy production 2 steps and increase your M€ production 4 steps. Spend 2 titanium. Place a habitat tile on The Moon and raise the habitat rate 1 step.

Tycho Road Network.name: Tycho Road Network
Tycho Road Network.description: Spend 1 steel. Increase your M€ production 1 step. Place a road tile on The Moon and raise the Logistics Rate 1 step.

Aristarchus Road Network.name: Aristarchus Road Network
Aristarchus Road Network.description: Spend 2 steel. Increase your M€ production 2 steps. Place a road tile on The Moon and raise the Logistics Rate 1 step.

Sinus Irdium Road Network.name: Sinus Irdium Road Network
Sinus Irdium Road Network.description: Decrease your energy production 1 step and increase your M€ production 3 steps. Spend 1 steel. Place a road tile on The Moon and raise the Logistics Rate 1 step.

Momentum Virium Habitat.name: Momentum Virium Habitat
Momentum Virium Habitat.description: Spend 1 titanium. Increase your heat production 2 steps and your M€ production 3 steps. Place a habitat tile ON THE RESERVED AREA and raise the habitat rate 1 step.

Luna Trade Station.name: Luna Trade Station
Luna Trade Station.description: Spend 2 titanium. Place this tile ON THE RESERVED AREA.

Luna Mining Hub.name: Luna Mining Hub
Luna Mining Hub.description: 2 VP PER MINING TILE ADJACENT TO THIS TILE.

Luna Train Station.name: Luna Train Station
Luna Train Station.description: Requires a logistic rate of 5 or higher. Spend 2 steel. Increase your M€ production 4 steps. Place this tile on The Moon and raise the logistic rate 1 step. 2 VP FOR EACH ROAD TILE ADJACENT TO THIS TILE.

Colonist Shuttles.name: Colonist Shuttles
Colonist Shuttles.description: Spend 1 titanium. Raise the habitat rate 1 step. Gain 2M€ for each habitat tile on The Moon.

Lunar Dust Processing Plant.name: Lunar Dust Processing Plant
Lunar Dust Processing Plant.description: Spend 1 titanium. Raise the logistic rate 1 step.

Deep Lunar Mining.name: Deep Lunar Mining
Deep Lunar Mining.description: Spend 1 titanium. Increase your titanium production 2 steps. Raise the mining rate 1 step.

Ancient Shipyards.name: Ancient Shipyards
Ancient Shipyards.description: Spend 3 titanium. -1 VP for every resource here.

Luna Resort.name: Luna Resort
Luna Resort.description: Requires 2 habitats on The Moon. Spend 2 titanium. Decrease your energy production 1 step and increase your M€ production 3 steps. Raise the habitat rate 1 step.

Lunar Observation Post.name: Lunar Observation Post
Lunar Observation Post.description: Spend 1 titanium. 1 VP for every 3 data resources here.

Mining Robots Manuf. Center.name: Mining Robots Manuf. Center
Mining Robots Manuf. Center.description: Spend 1 titanium. Raise the mining rate 2 steps.

Pride of the Earth Arkship.name: Pride of the Earth Arkship
Pride of the Earth Arkship.description: Requires 1 science and 2 space tags. Spend 2 titanium. 1 VP per science resource here.

Iron Extraction Center.name: Iron Extraction Center
Iron Extraction Center.description: Spend 1 titanium. Increase your steel production 1 step for every 2 raised steps of mining rate.

Titanium Extraction Center.name: Titanium Extraction Center
Titanium Extraction Center.description: Spend 2 titanium. Increase your titanium production 1 step for every 2 raised steps of mining rate.

Archimedes Hydroponics Station.name: Archimedes Hydroponics Station
Archimedes Hydroponics Station.description: Decrease your energy production 1 step and your M€ production 1 step. Increase your plant production 2 steps.

Steel Market Monopolists.name: Steel Market Monopolists
Steel Market Monopolists.description: Requires the mining rate to be 3 or higher.

Titanium Market Monopolists.name: Titanium Market Monopolists
Titanium Market Monopolists.description: Requires the mining rate to be 3 or higher.

Luna Staging Station.name: Luna Staging Station
Luna Staging Station.description: Requires the logistic rate to be 2 or higher. Spend 1 titanium. Raise the logistic rate 2 steps.

New Colony Planning Initiatives.name: New Colony Planning Initiatives
New Colony Planning Initiatives.description: Requires the habitat rate to be 2 or higher. Raise the habitat rate 1 step.

AI Controlled Mine Network.name: AI Controlled Mine Network
AI Controlled Mine Network.description: Requires the logistic rate to be 2 or higher. Raise the logistic rate 1 step

Darkside Meteor Bombardment.name: Darkside Meteor Bombardment
Darkside Meteor Bombardment.description: Gain 2 steel and 2 titanium. Raise the mining rate 2 steps.

Underground Detonators.name: Underground Detonators
Underground Detonators.description: Gain 1 steel and 1 titanium. Raise the mining rate 1 step.

Lunar Trade Fleet.name: Lunar Trade Fleet
Lunar Trade Fleet.description: Requires that you have 2 titanium production. Increase your M€ production 1 step. Raise the logistic rate 1 step.

Subterranean Habitats.name: Subterranean Habitats
Subterranean Habitats.description: Spend 2 steel. Raise the habitat rate 1 step.

Improved Moon Concrete.name: Improved Moon Concrete
Improved Moon Concrete.description: Spend 2 steel. Raise the mining rate 1 step.

Heavy Duty Rovers.name: Heavy Duty Rovers
Heavy Duty Rovers.description: Gain 4 M€ for each mining tile adjacent to a road tile. Raise the logistic rate 1 step.

Microsingularity Plant.name: Microsingularity Plant
Microsingularity Plant.description: Requires 2 habitats on The Moon. Increase your energy production 2 steps.

Heliostat Mirror Array.name: Heliostat Mirror Array
Heliostat Mirror Array.description: Spend 1 titanium. Gain 1 heat. Increase your energy production 2 steps.

Lunar Security Stations.name: Lunar Security Stations
Lunar Security Stations.description: Requires 3 road tiles on The Moon. Raise the logistic rate 1 step.

Hypersensitive Silicon Chip Factory.name: Hypersensitive Silicon Chip Factory
Hypersensitive Silicon Chip Factory.description: Requires 2 mining tiles on The Moon. Spend 2 titanium. Increase your M€ production 4 steps.

Copernicus Solar Arrays.name: Copernicus Solar Arrays
Copernicus Solar Arrays.description: Spend 1 titanium. Gain 2 heat. Incease your energy production 1 step.

Darkside Incubation Plant.name: Darkside Incubation Plant
Darkside Incubation Plant.description: Spend 1 titanium. 1 VP for every 2 microbes here.

Water Treatment Complex.name: Water Treatment Complex
Water Treatment Complex.description: Requires 1 habitat tile on The Moon. Spend 1 titanium. Raise the habitat rate 2 steps.

Algae Bioreactors.name: Algae Bioreactors
Algae Bioreactors.description: Decrease your plant production 1 step. Raise the habitat rate 1 step and oxygen 1%.

HE3 Fusion Plant.name: HE3 Fusion Plant
HE3 Fusion Plant.description: Requires the mining rate of 2 or higher. Increase your energy production 1 step for each mining tile on The Moon.

HE3 Lobbyists.name: HE3 Lobbyists
HE3 Lobbyists.description: Increase your M€ production 1 step for each Moon tag you have (including this).

Revolting Colonists.name: Revolting Colonists
Revolting Colonists.description: Requires 4 habitat rate. All players pay 3M€ for each habitat tile they own.

Cosmic Radiation.name: Cosmic Radiation
Cosmic Radiation.description: Requires 4 mining rate. All players pay 4M€ for each mining tile they own.

Off-World City Living.name: Off-World City Living
Off-World City Living.description: Increase your M€ production 1 step per city tile NOT ON MARS. Increase habitat rate 1 step.

Road Piracy.name: Road Piracy
Road Piracy.description: Requires 3 logistic rate. Steal up to 6 steel or 4 titanium from other players. (Resources may be stolen from more than 1 opponent.)

Lunar Mine Urbanization.name: Lunar Mine Urbanization
Lunar Mine Urbanization.description: Requires you have 1 mine tile. Increase your M€ production 1 step. Raise the habitat rate 1 step. Remove 1 of your mine tiles (does not affect the mining rate.) Place this special tile there, regardless of placement rules. Gain placement bonuses as usual. This tile counts both as a habitat and a mine tile.

Thorium Rush.name: Thorium Rush
Thorium Rush.description: Place 1 habitat tile, 1 mining tile and 1 road tile on The Moon. Raise the habitat rate, mining rate and logistic rate 1 step.

HE3 Production Quotas.name: HE3 Production Quotas
HE3 Production Quotas.description: Requires that Kelvinists are ruling or that you have 2 delegates there, and 1 mine tile on The Moon. Pay 1 steel per mine tile on The Moon to gain 4 heat per mine tile on The Moon. Raise the mining rate 1 step.

Luna Conference.name: Luna Conference
Luna Conference.description: Requires that Scientists are ruling or that you have 2 delegates there. Gain 2 M€ per road tile on The Moon. Gain 2M€ per habitat tile on The Moon.

We Grow As One.name: We Grow As One
We Grow As One.description: Requires that Unity are ruling or that you have 2 delegates there. Increase ALL colony tile tracks 1 step. Increase each colony tile track 1 step if you have a colony on that colony tile.

Mooncrate Convoys To Mars.name: Mooncrate Convoys To Mars
Mooncrate Convoys To Mars.description: Requires that Mars First are ruling or that you have 2 delegates there. Raise the logistic rate 1 step. All players may sell their steel resources for 3M€ each.

An Offer You Can't Refuse.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
An Offer You Can't Refuse.description: Exchange a NON-NEUTRAL opponent delegate with one of your own from the reserve. This exchange may not change the party leader. You may then move your delegate to another party.

Preliminary Darkside.name: Preliminary Darkside
Preliminary Darkside.description: Gain 3 titanium or 4 steel. Raise the mining rate 1 step.

Hostile Takeover.name: Hostile Takeover
Hostile Takeover.description: Requires a habitat rate of 2 or higher, and a mining rate of 4 or higher. Add your player marker to a habitat tile and a mining tile owned by any opponent. Those now also count as yours. Increase your M€ production 2 steps.

Syndicate Pirate Raids.name: Syndicate Pirate Raids
Syndicate Pirate Raids.description: ALL OPPONENTS CANNOT RETRIEVE THEIR TRADE FLEETS THIS GENERATION

Darkside Mining Syndicate.name: Darkside Mining Syndicate
Darkside Mining Syndicate.description: Increase your titanium production 2 steps, or 1 step if the mining rate is at least 2. And then raise the mining rate 1 step.

Staging Station \"Behemoth\".name: Staging Station "Behemoth"
Staging Station \"Behemoth\".description: Gain 2 Trade Fleets. Raise the logistic rate 1 step.

Luna Senate.name: Luna Senate
Luna Senate.description: Requires that you have 3 Moon tags. Increase your M€ production 1 step per Moon tag your OPPONENTS have.

Luna Political Institute.name: Luna Political Institute
Luna Political Institute.description: Requires that you have 2 Moon tags.

Small Duty Rovers.name: Small Duty Rovers
Small Duty Rovers.description: Spend 1 titanium. Raise the logistic rate 1 step. Gain 1 M€ per habitat tile, mine tile and road tile on The Moon.

Lunar Industry Complex.name: Lunar Industry Complex
Lunar Industry Complex.description: Spend 2 titanium. Place a mine tile on The Moon and raise the mining rate 1 step. Increase your steel, titanium, and heat production 1 step each. Increase your energy production 2 steps.

Martian Embassy.name: Martian Embassy
Martian Embassy.description: Raise the Mars Planetary Track 1 step for every 3 Moon tags you have, including this.

Rover Drivers Union.name: Rover Drivers Union
Rover Drivers Union.description: Requires 2 logistic rate. Raise the logistic rate 1 step. Increase your M€ production 1 step per logistic rate.

L.T.F. Headquarters.name: L.T.F. Headquarters
L.T.F. Headquarters.description: Raise the habitat rate 1 step. Place a colony. Gain 1 Trade Fleet.

Undermoon Drug Lords Network.name: Undermoon Drug Lords Network
Undermoon Drug Lords Network.description: Increase your M€ production 1 step per 2 steps of habitat rate.

Grand Luna Academy.name: Grand Luna Academy
Grand Luna Academy.description: Draw 1 card per 2 Moon tags you have, including this.

Luna Ecumenopolis.name: Luna Ecumenopolis
Luna Ecumenopolis.description: Spend 2 titanium. Place 2 habitat tiles adjacent to at least 2 other habitat tiles and raise habitat rate 2 steps. Increase your TR 1 step for each 2 steps of the habitat rate.

Orbital Power Grid.name: Orbital Power Grid
Orbital Power Grid.description: Increase your energy production 1 step per city tile NOT ON MARS.

Nanotech Industries.name: Nanotech Industries
Nanotech Industries.description: You start with 42 M€. As your first action, draw 3 cards. Take 2 of them into hand, and discard the rest. 1 VP for every 2 science resources here.

Tempest Consultancy.name: Tempest Consultancy
Tempest Consultancy.description: You start with 37 M€. As your first action, place 2 delegates in one party.

The Darkside of The Moon Syndicate.name: The Darkside of The Moon Syndicate

Luna Hyperloop Corporation.name: Luna Hyperloop Corporation
Luna Hyperloop Corporation.description: You start with 38 M€ and 4 steel.

Crescent Research Association.name: Crescent Research Association
Crescent Research Association.description: You start with 50 M€. 1 VP for every 3 Moon tags you have.

Luna First Incorporated.name: Luna First Incorporated
Luna First Incorporated.description: You start with 40 M€, 1 steel, and 1 titanium.

The Grand Luna Capital Group.name: The Grand Luna Capital Group
The Grand Luna Capital Group.description: You start with 32 M€ and 1 titanium. As your first action, place a habitat tile on The Moon and raise the habitat rate 1 step.

Intragen Sanctuary Headquarters.name: Intragen Sanctuary Headquarters
Intragen Sanctuary Headquarters.description: You start with 38 M€. As your first action, place a habitat tile on The Moon and raise the habitat rate 1 step. 1 VP for every 2 animals on this card.

Luna Trade Federation.name: Luna Trade Federation
Luna Trade Federation.description: You start with 15 M€ and 10 titanium.

First Lunar Settlement.name: First Lunar Settlement
First Lunar Settlement.description: Place a habitat tile on The Moon and raise the habitat rate 1 step. Increase your M€ production 1 step.

Core Mine.name: Core Mine
Core Mine.description: Place a mine tile on The Moon and raise the mining rate 1 step. Increase your titanium production 1 step.

Basic Infrastructure.name: Basic Infrastructure
Basic Infrastructure.description: Place a road tile on The Moon and raise the Logistics Rate 1 step. Gain 1 trade fleet.

Lunar Planning Office.name: Lunar Planning Office
Lunar Planning Office.description: Draw 2 cards with a Moon tag. Gain 6 steel.

Mining Complex.name: Mining Complex
Mining Complex.description: Place a mine tile on The Moon and raise the mining rate 1 step. Place a road tile adjacent to placed mine tile and raise the Logistics Rate 1 step. Pay 7 M€.

Breeding Farms.name: Breeding Farms
Breeding Farms.description: Requires 1 science tag and 1 animal tag. Raise the temperature 1 step.

Prefabrication of Human Habitats.name: Prefabrication of Human Habitats
Prefabrication of Human Habitats.description: Requires that you have steel production.

New Venice.name: New Venice
New Venice.description: Requires 3 ocean tiles. Lose 2 plants. Increase your energy production 1 step and your M€ production 2 steps. Place this tile on top of an existing ocean tile, IGNORING NORMAL PLACEMENT RESTRICTIONS FOR CITIES. The tile counts as a city as well as an ocean.

Rare-Earth Elements.name: Rare-Earth Elements
Rare-Earth Elements.description: Increase your M€ production by 1 for every special tile you own on Mars.

Orbital Laboratories.name: Orbital Laboratories
Orbital Laboratories.description: Increase your plant production 2 steps. Gain 1 plant.

Dust Storm.name: Dust Storm
Dust Storm.description: Every player loses all energy. Raise the temperature 2 steps.

Martian Monuments.name: Martian Monuments
Martian Monuments.description: Requires that you own a city ON MARS. Raise your M€ production 1 step for every Mars tag you own (including this.)

Martian Nature Wonders.name: Martian Nature Wonders
Martian Nature Wonders.description: Place a neutral player cube on a non-reserved space. No tile can be placed on that space this game. Gather any bonus on that space, but no bonuses from adjacent spaces. Add 2 data to ANY card.

Museum of Early Colonisation.name: Museum of Early Colonisation
Museum of Early Colonisation.description: Requires 1 ocean, 1 city and one greenery on Mars. Decrease your energy production 1 step. Raise your steel, titanium, and plant production 1 step. Gain 1 TR.

Ceres Spaceport.name: Ceres Spaceport
Ceres Spaceport.description: Increase your M€ production 2 steps, and titanium production 1 step for every 2 Jovian tags (including these.) Draw a card. Place an ocean tile. Place a city tile ON THE RESERVED AREA.

Dyson Screens.name: Dyson Screens
Dyson Screens.description: Raise the temperature 1 step. Draw a card. Place a city tile ON THE RESERVED AREA. Raise your energy and heat production 2 steps.

Lunar Embassy.name: Lunar Embassy
Lunar Embassy.description: Increase your M€ production 3 steps, and plant production 1 step for every 2 Earth tags (including this.) Draw a card. Place a city tile ON THE RESERVED AREA.

Early Expedition.name: Early Expedition
Early Expedition.description: Temperature must be -18 C or lower. Decrease your energy production 1 step and Raise your M€ production 3 steps. Add 1 data to ANY card. Place a city tile on Mars NEXT TO NO OTHER TILE.

Hydrogen Processing Plant.name: Hydrogen Processing Plant
Hydrogen Processing Plant.description: Oxygen level must be 3% or higher. Decrease oxygen level 1% Raise your energy production 1 step for every two ocean tiles on Mars.

Power Plant:Pathfinders.name: Power Plant:Pathfinders
Power Plant:Pathfinders.description: Increase your heat production 2 steps and your energy production 1 step.

Luxury Estate.name: Luxury Estate
Luxury Estate.description: Oxygen must be 7% or greater. Gain 1 titanium for each city tile and greenery tile you own.

Designed Organisms.name: Designed Organisms
Designed Organisms.description: Requires 5 science tags. Increase your plant production 2 steps. Gain 3 plants. Add 3 microbes to ANY card. Add 1 animal to ANY card.

Space Debris Cleaning Operation.name: Space Debris Cleaning Operation
Space Debris Cleaning Operation.description: Requires any 4 space tags in play. Gain 3 titanium. Add 1 resource to ANY card (not cards that take ANIMAL or SCIENCE resources.) Add 1 data to ANY card. Draw 1 card.

Secret Labs.name: Secret Labs
Secret Labs.description: Requires 1 science tag and 1 Jovian tag. Place an ocean tile. Add 2 microbes to ANY card. OR Raise temperature 1 step. Gain 3 plants. OR Raise oxygen level 1 step. Add 2 floaters to ANY card.

Cyanobacteria.name: Cyanobacteria
Cyanobacteria.description: Raise the oxygen level 1%. For every ocean tile, add a microbe to ANY card.

Communication Center.name: Communication Center
Communication Center.description: Decrease your energy production 1 step. Place 2 data on this card.

Martian Repository.name: Martian Repository
Martian Repository.description: Decrease your energy production 1 step. 1 VP for every 3 data here.

Small Open Pit Mine.name: Small Open Pit Mine
Small Open Pit Mine.description: Increase your steel production 2 steps OR increase your titanium production 1 step.

Solar Storm.name: Solar Storm
Solar Storm.description: Every player loses 2 plants. Remove up to 3 data from any player. Raise your heat production 1 step. Raise the temperature 1 step.

Declaration of Independence.name: Declaration of Independence
Declaration of Independence.description: Requires that you have at least 6 Mars tags in play. Place 2 delegates in any party.

Martian Culture.name: Martian Culture
Martian Culture.description: Requires ANY 2 Mars tags in play.  1 VP for every 2 data here.

Small Comet.name: Small Comet
Small Comet.description: Every player loses 2 plants. Raise the temperature 1 step. Raise the oxygen 1 step. Place an ocean ON AN AREA NOT RESERVED FOR OCEAN. Gain 1 titanium.

Flat Mars Theory.name: Flat Mars Theory
Flat Mars Theory.description: Requires maximum 1 science tag. Increase your M€ production 1 step for every generation played so far.

Asteroid Resources.name: Asteroid Resources
Asteroid Resources.description: Spend 3 energy. Either increase your steel and titanium production one step, OR place an ocean, and gain 2 steel and one titanium.

Kickstarter.name: Kickstarter
Kickstarter.description: Choose a planet tag. This card counts as having 1 of that tag. Raise the corresponding planetary track 3 steps in total.

Economic Help.name: Economic Help
Economic Help.description: Raise the lowest non-completed planetary influence track 3 steps. When tied, raise all lowest tracks 2 steps. Increase your M€ production 1 step

Interplanetary Transport.name: Interplanetary Transport
Interplanetary Transport.description: Increase your M€ production 1 step for every offworld city tile.

Martian Dust Processing Plant.name: Martian Dust Processing Plant
Martian Dust Processing Plant.description: Decrease your energy production 1 step, and raise your steel production 2 steps. Gain 1 TR.

Cultivation of Venus.name: Cultivation of Venus
Cultivation of Venus.description: 1 VP for every 2 Venus tags you own.

Expedition to the Surface - Venus.name: Expedition to the Surface - Venus
Expedition to the Surface - Venus.description: Draw 2 cards. Raise Venus 1 step. Gain 1M€ for each of your Venus tags, including this.

Botanical Experience.name: Botanical Experience
Botanical Experience.description: Requires one greenery tile on Mars.

Rich Deposits.name: Rich Deposits
Rich Deposits.description: Requires 2 science tags. Increase your steel production 3 steps.

Oumuamua Type Object Survey.name: Oumuamua Type Object Survey
Oumuamua Type Object Survey.description: Requires 1 space tag and 1 science tag. Add 2 data to ANY card.

Solarpedia.name: Solarpedia
Solarpedia.description: Requires 1 Venus, Earth, Mars, and Jovian Tag. Add 2 data to ANY card. 1 VP for every 6 data resources here.

Anthozoa.name: Anthozoa
Anthozoa.description: Requires 3 oceans on Mars. 1 VP per 2 animals on this card.

Advanced Power Grid.name: Advanced Power Grid
Advanced Power Grid.description: Increase your energy production 2 steps. Increase your M€ production 1 step per power tag you have, including this.

Specialized Settlement.name: Specialized Settlement
Specialized Settlement.description: Decrease your energy production 1 step and increase your M€ production 3 steps. Place a city tile on Mars. Increase your production by 1 of a resource on the map gained by placement bonus.

Huygens Observatory.name: Huygens Observatory
Huygens Observatory.description: Place a colony. MAY BE PLACED ON A COLONY TILE WHERE YOU ALREADY HAVE A COLONY. Trade for free. You may use a Trade Fleet that is already on a colony tile, but you may not trade with the tile that fleet came from. Gain 1 TR.

Cassini Station.name: Cassini Station
Cassini Station.description: Increase your energy production 1 step for every colony in play. Add 2 floaters to ANY card OR add 3 data to ANY card.

Coordinated Raid.name: Coordinated Raid
Coordinated Raid.description: Requires at least 1 colony in play. Send one of your unused Trade Fleets to any colony tile. Collect the trade bonus and colony bonus for every colony on this tile. Other players do not get their colony bonuses from this action.

Lobby Halls.name: Lobby Halls
Lobby Halls.description: Increase your M€ production 2 steps. Place 1 delegate in any party. Choose a planet tag. This card counts as having 1 of that tag. Raise the corresponding planetary track 1 step.

Red City.name: Red City
Red City.description: Requires that Reds are ruling or that you have 2 delegates there. -1 energy prod, +2 M€ prod. Place the special tile on Mars ADJACENT TO NO GREENERY. NO GREENERY MAY BE PLACED NEXT TO THIS TILE. 1 VP for every empty space (or hazard) next to this tile.

Venera Base.name: Venera Base
Venera Base.description: Requires Unity is ruling or that you have 2 delegates there. Raise your M€ production 3 steps and place a city tile ON THE RESERVED AREA.

Soil Detoxification.name: Soil Detoxification
Soil Detoxification.description: Requires that Greens are ruling or you have 2 delegates there. Increase your plant production 1 step

High Temp. Superconductors.name: High Temp. Superconductors
High Temp. Superconductors.description: Requires Kelvinists are ruling or you have 2 delegates there. Increase your energy production 2 steps.

Public Sponsored Grant.name: Public Sponsored Grant
Public Sponsored Grant.description: Requires Scientists are ruling or that you have 2 delegates there. All players lose 2M€. Choose a tag (NOT CITY, ? OR PLANETARY TRACK) and draw 2 cards with that tag.

Pollinators.name: Pollinators
Pollinators.description: Requires 3 plant tags. Raise your plant production 1 step and your M€ production 2 steps.

Social Events.name: Social Events
Social Events.description: Gain 1 TR for every 2 Mars tags you have (including this one.)

Controlled Bloom.name: Controlled Bloom
Controlled Bloom.description: Requires 3 oceans. Add 3 microbes to ANY card. Gain 3 plants.

Polaris.name: Polaris
Polaris.description: You start with 32 M€. As your first action, place an ocean tile.

Ambient.name: Ambient
Ambient.description: You start with 38 M€. As your first action, raise the Venus scale 2 steps.

Ringcom.name: Ringcom
Ringcom.description: You start with 39 M€. and 3 M€ production. As your first action, draw 2 cards with a Jovian tag.

Chimera.name: Chimera
Chimera.description: You start with 36 M€, 1 steel, and 1 titanium.

Soylent Seedling Systems.name: Soylent Seedling Systems
Soylent Seedling Systems.description: You start with 38M€ and 2 seeds on this card.

Mars Maths.name: Mars Maths
Mars Maths.description: You start with 40 M€. As your first action, draw 2 cards

Martian Insurance Group.name: Martian Insurance Group
Martian Insurance Group.description: You start with 42 M€ and 1 M€ production.

Bio-Sol.name: Bio-Sol
Bio-Sol.description: You start with 42 M€. As your first action, draw 2 cards with a microbe tag.

Aurorai.name: Aurorai
Aurorai.description: You start with 33 M€. and 2 data on this card

Collegium Copernicus.name: Collegium Copernicus
Collegium Copernicus.description: You start with 33 M€. As your first action, draw 2 cards with a science tag.

Gagarin Mobile Base.name: Gagarin Mobile Base
Gagarin Mobile Base.description: You start with 42 M€. As your first action, put Gagarin Mobile Base on ANY area on Mars. Collect the bonus.

Mind Set Mars.name: Mind Set Mars
Mind Set Mars.description: You start with 44 M€ and 1 agenda resource to this card.

Venus First.name: Venus First
Venus First.description: Raise Venus 2 steps. Draw 2 Venus cards.

Valuable Gases:Pathfinders.name: Valuable Gases:Pathfinders
Valuable Gases:Pathfinders.description: Gain 10 M€. PLAY AN ACTIVE FLOATER CARD FROM HAND, IGNORING GLOBAL REQUIREMENTS, and add 5 floaters to it.

CO² Reducers.name: CO² Reducers
CO² Reducers.description: Increase your M€ production 3 steps. Draw 2 cards with a microbe tag.

Hydrogen Bombardment.name: Hydrogen Bombardment
Hydrogen Bombardment.description: Increase the Venus scale 1 step. Increase your titanium production 1 step. Gain 6 M€.

Research Grant:Pathfinders.name: Research Grant:Pathfinders
Research Grant:Pathfinders.description: Increase your energy production 1 step. Gain 14 M€.

Crew Training.name: Crew Training
Crew Training.description: Choose a planet tag. This card counts as having 2 of that tag. Raise the corresponding planetary track 2 steps. Gain 2 TR.

Survey Mission.name: Survey Mission
Survey Mission.description: Gain 5 steel. Land-claim three non-reserved spaces in a triangle shape. Gain all placement bonuses. Only you may place tiles there, and will gain placement bonuses again.

Design Company.name: Design Company
Design Company.description: Increase your steel production 1 step. Draw 3 cards with a building tag.

Personal Agenda.name: Personal Agenda
Personal Agenda.description: Increase your M€ production 3 steps. Draw 3 event cards that do not have a space tag.

Vital Colony.name: Vital Colony
Vital Colony.description: Place a colony. Receive the placement bonus twice.

Deep Space Operations.name: Deep Space Operations
Deep Space Operations.description: Gain 4 titanium. Draw 2 event cards with a space tag.

Experienced Martians.name: Experienced Martians
Experienced Martians.description: Place 1 delegate in any party. Draw 2 cards with a Mars tag. Increase your M€ production 2 steps.

The New Space Race.name: The New Space Race
The New Space Race.description: REVEALED BEFORE ANY OTHER PRELUDE. You become starting player for the game. Choose and set a ruling policy for the first generation. Gain 12 M€.

Apollo.name: Apollo
Apollo.description: Once per game, gain 3 M€ for each tile on The Moon.

Asimov.name: Asimov
Asimov.description: Once per game, draw 10-X awards (min. 1), where X is the current generation number. You may put one into the game and fund it for free.

Bjorn.name: Bjorn
Bjorn.description: Once per game, steal X+2 M€ from each player that has more M€ than you, where X is the current generation number.

Caesar.name: Caesar
Caesar.description: Once per game, place X hazard tiles where X is the current generation number. Each opponent loses 1 unit of production of their choice, or 2 units if there are 6 or more hazard tiles.

Clarke.name: Clarke
Clarke.description: Once per game, increase your plant and heat production 1 step each. Gain plants and heat equal to your production +4.

Duncan.name: Duncan
Duncan.description: Once per game, gain 7-X VP and 4X M€, where X is the current generation number.

Ender.name: Ender
Ender.description: Once per game, discard any number of cards up to twice the current generation number to draw that many cards.

Faraday.name: Faraday
Faraday.description: When you gain a multiple of 5 for any tag type IN PLAY, you may pay 3 M€ to draw a card with that tag. Wild tags do not count for this effect.

Floyd.name: Floyd
Floyd.description: Once per game, play a card from hand for 13 + 2X M€ less, where X is the current generation number.

Gaia.name: Gaia
Gaia.description: Once per game, gain the Ares adjacency bonuses of all player-owned tiles on Mars.

Greta.name: Greta
Greta.description: When you take an action or play a card that increases your TR THIS GENERATION (max 10 times), gain 4 M€.

HAL 9000.name: HAL 9000
HAL 9000.description: Once per game, decrease each of your productions 1 step to gain 4 of that resource.

Huan.name: Huan
Huan.description: ALL OPPONENTS CANNOT TRADE NEXT GENERATION. Gain 1 Trade Fleet.

Ingrid.name: Ingrid
Ingrid.description: When you take an action that places a tile on Mars THIS GENERATION, draw a card.

Jansson.name: Jansson
Jansson.description: Once per game, gain all placement bonuses under your tiles on Mars.

Karen.name: Karen
Karen.description: Once per game, draw Prelude cards equal to the current generation number and choose one to play, and discard the rest.

Lowell.name: Lowell
Lowell.description: Once per game, pay 8 M€ to draw 3 CEO cards and choose one to play. Discard this card.

Maria.name: Maria
Maria.description: Once per game, draw colony tiles equal to the current generation number. Put one into play and build a colony on it for free if possible.

Musk.name: Musk
Musk.description: Once per game, discard any number of Earth cards to draw that many space cards, and gain that many units of titanium, plus 6.

Naomi.name: Naomi
Naomi.description: Once per game, move each colony tile track marker to its highest or lowest value.

Neil.name: Neil
Neil.description: Once per game, increase your M€ production by the value of the LOWEST Moon rate.

Oscar.name: Oscar
Oscar.description: Once per game, replace the Chairman with one of your delegates.

Petra.name: Petra
Petra.description: Once per game, replace all Neutral delegates with your delegates. Gain 3 M€ for each delegate replaced this way. Place 3 Neutral delegates.

Quill.name: Quill
Quill.description: Once per game, add 2 floaters to each of your cards that collect floaters, then add 2 floaters to ANY card. Gain 1 M€ for every 2 floaters added this way.

Rogers.name: Rogers
Rogers.description: Ignore global requirements for your Venus cards THIS GENERATION. When you play a Venus tag THIS GENERATION, you pay 3 M€ less for it.

Ryu.name: Ryu
Ryu.description: Once per game, swap up to X+2 units of production between two resources, where X is the current generation number.

Shara.name: Shara
Shara.description: Once per game, choose a planet tag. This card counts as having immediately played 2 of that tag. Then gain M€ equal to that tags planety influence track.

Stefan.name: Stefan
Stefan.description: Once per game, sell any number of cards from your hand for 3 M€ each.

Tate.name: Tate
Tate.description: Once per game, name a tag. Reveal cards from the deck until you find 5 cards with that tag. BUY up to 2 cards and discard the rest.

Ulrich.name: Ulrich
Ulrich.description: Once per game, gain 4 M€ for each ocean placed. If all oceans are aleady placed, gain only 15 M€.

Will.name: Will
Will.description: Once per game, add the following resources to your cards: 2 animals, 2 microbes, 2 floaters, 2 wild.

Xu.name: Xu
Xu.description: Once per game, gain 2 M€ for each Venus tag in play. Gain an additional 8 M€ if you have the most Venus tags in play.

Yvonne.name: Yvonne
Yvonne.description: Once per game, gain all your colony bonuses twice.

Zan.name: Zan
Zan.description: Once per game, place all of your available delegates in Reds. Gain 1 M€ for each delegate placed this way.

Clone Troopers (II).name: Clone Troopers (II)
Clone Troopers (II).description: Requires 6 ocean tiles. 1 VP per Clone Trooper on this card.

Behold The Emperor! (III).name: Behold The Emperor! (III)
Behold The Emperor! (III).description: Requires that you are Chairman. The current ruling party will automatically be the ruling party during the next Solar phase, and you will remain the Chairman. (As if the current ruling party were dominant and you were its party leader.)

Cloud City (V).name: Cloud City (V)
Cloud City (V).description: Requires Venus 6%. Raise Venus 1 step. Add 2 floaters to any card.

Forest Moon (VI).name: Forest Moon (VI)
Forest Moon (VI).description: Requires any 4 greeneries on Mars. Decrease any energy production 2 steps. Add an animal to any card.

Takonda Castle (VII).name: Takonda Castle (VII)
Takonda Castle (VII).description: Gain 1 M€ for each of your microbe tags and animal tags.

Tool with the First Order (VIII).name: Tool with the First Order (VIII)
Tool with the First Order (VIII).description: Take another action this turn. Gain 1 TR.

Rey ... Skywalker?! (IX).name: Rey ... Skywalker?! (IX)
Rey ... Skywalker?! (IX).description: Raise your M€ production 4 steps. Place a bronze cube on an empty unreserved space on Mars. No tile or token may be placed on that space for the rest of the game.

Geoscan Satellite.name: Geoscan Satellite
Geoscan Satellite.description: Pick a space on the board. Identify the underground resource in that space and in all adjacent spaces. Claim one of them.

Underground Railway.name: Underground Railway
Underground Railway.description: Decrease your energy production 1 step. Gain 1 TR for every 4 underground tokens you have.

Gaia City.name: Gaia City
Gaia City.description: Reduce your energy production one step and increase your plant production 2 steps. Place a city on a NON-RESERVED SPACE WITH YOUR EXCAVATION MARKER, ignoring other placement restrictions

Deepnuking.name: Deepnuking
Deepnuking.description: Excavate 2 underground resources. Remove up to 3 plants from any player.

Old World Mafia.name: Old World Mafia
Old World Mafia.description: Gain 1 corruption for every 2 Earth tags you have, including this.

Nightclubs.name: Nightclubs
Nightclubs.description: Requires that you own a city in play. Gain 1 corruption and increase your M€ production 2 steps.

Reckless Detonation.name: Reckless Detonation
Reckless Detonation.description: Requires 2 corruption. Excavate an underground resource. Remove up to 3 steel or 2 titanium from any player.

Off-World Tax Haven.name: Off-World Tax Haven
Off-World Tax Haven.description: Requires 2 corruption. Increase your M€ production 5 steps.

Subnautic Pirates.name: Subnautic Pirates
Subnautic Pirates.description: Requires you have 1 corruption and 1 underground token. Steal up to 7 M€ from a player that HAS A TILE NEXT TO AN OCEAN.

Fabricated Scandal.name: Fabricated Scandal
Fabricated Scandal.description: Gain 1 corruption. The players with the highest TR lose 1 TR. Then the players with the lowest TR gain 1 TR, if possible.

Subterranean Sea.name: Subterranean Sea
Subterranean Sea.description: Place an ocean tile ON AN AREA NOT RESERVED FOR OCEAN where you have an excavation marker.

Forest Tunnels.name: Forest Tunnels
Forest Tunnels.description: Gain 1 plant for each underground token you own.

Tunneling Subcontractor.name: Tunneling Subcontractor
Tunneling Subcontractor.description: Gain 1 corruption. Excavate an underground resource.

Underground Amusement Park.name: Underground Amusement Park
Underground Amusement Park.description: Requires you have 1 underground token. Increase your M€ production 1 step.

Casino.name: Casino
Casino.description: Requires that you own 2 city tiles. Gain 1 corruption. Increase your M€ production 4 steps.

Microprobing Technology.name: Microprobing Technology
Microprobing Technology.description: Requires 1 science tag. Gain 3 plants. Identify 2 underground resources. Claim 1 of them.

Geothermal Network.name: Geothermal Network
Geothermal Network.description: Requires 3 underground tokens. Increase your heat production 3 steps.

Global Audit.name: Global Audit
Global Audit.description: Every player with the lowest number of crime tags INCLUDING EVENTS gains 1 TR, if possible. Players with 0 crime tags gain 1 additional TR.

Patent Manipulation.name: Patent Manipulation
Patent Manipulation.description: RETURN 1 OF YOUR PLAYED GREEN OR BLUE CARDS TO YOUR HAND. IT MAY NOT BE A CARD THAT PLACES SPECIAL TILES OR RETURNS PLAYED CARDS TO YOUR HAND.

Cave City.name: Cave City
Cave City.description: Increase your steel production 1 step. Place a city in a NON-RESERVED SPACE WITH YOUR EXCAVATION MARKER, ignoring other placement restrictions

Underground Smuggling Ring.name: Underground Smuggling Ring
Underground Smuggling Ring.description: Requires you have 1 underground token. Gain 1 corruption and 2 of the same standard resource.

Deepmining.name: Deepmining
Deepmining.description: Excavate an underground resource that depicts steel or titanium ANYWHERE ON THE BOARD. Increase your production of that resource 1 step.

Tunneling Loophole.name: Tunneling Loophole
Tunneling Loophole.description: Requires 1 Earth tag. Until the end of this generation, you can excavate ignoring placement restrictions. Excavate 1 underground resource. Gain 1 corruption.

Orbital Laser Drill.name: Orbital Laser Drill
Orbital Laser Drill.description: Requires 2 science tags. Excavate 2 underground resources, IGNORING PLACEMENT RESTRICTIONS.

Landfill.name: Landfill
Landfill.description: Increase your M€ production 1 step for each different TYPE of production you have at least 1 step of.

Corporate Blackmail.name: Corporate Blackmail
Corporate Blackmail.description: Requires 1 corruption. Target a player that has at least 3 corruption. That player pays you 10 M€ or 2 corruption - their choice.

Robot Moles.name: Robot Moles
Robot Moles.description: Gain 2 steel. Identify 4 underground resources. Claim 1 of them.

Server Sabotage.name: Server Sabotage
Server Sabotage.description: Gain 1 corruption. Draw a card. Remove all underground resources from the board.

Private Military Contractor.name: Private Military Contractor
Private Military Contractor.description: Add 1 fighter resource to this card.

Personal Spacecruiser.name: Personal Spacecruiser
Personal Spacecruiser.description: Gain 1 corruption. Put 1 fighter on ANY card.

Hyperspace Drive Prototype.name: Hyperspace Drive Prototype
Hyperspace Drive Prototype.description: Requires that 3 science tags. Put a fighter resource on a card you own, or gain 1 titanium if you have no suitable card. Put a science resource on a card you own, or gain 1 TR if you have no suitable card.

Star Vegas.name: Star Vegas
Star Vegas.description: Requires any 3 cities in play. Place a city on a space reserved for a different space city. Gain 2 corruption. Increase your M€ production one step for each city in play.

Private Resorts.name: Private Resorts
Private Resorts.description: Requires 3 oceans. Reduce your heat production 1 step. Increase your M€ production 3 steps. Gain 1 corruption.

Micro-Geodesics.name: Micro-Geodesics
Micro-Geodesics.description: Excavate an underground resource. Put 1 microbe on this card.

Neutrinograph.name: Neutrinograph
Neutrinograph.description: Requires 5 science tags. Identify 7 underground resources. Claim 3 of them.

Artesian Aquifer.name: Artesian Aquifer
Artesian Aquifer.description: Excavate 1 underground resource on ANY SPACE RESERVED FOR AN OCEAN. Then, place an ocean tile there, if possible.

Underground Research Center.name: Underground Research Center
Underground Research Center.description: Requires you have 4 underground tokens. Excavate an underground resource. Choose a tag that is not the wild tag or clone tag. Draw a card with that tag.

Price Wars.name: Price Wars
Price Wars.description: Requires 2 corruption. Until the end of this generation, your steel and titanium are worth 1 more M€ each, and steel and titanium for other players is worth 1 M€ less.

Monopoly.name: Monopoly
Monopoly.description: Requires 2 corruption. Choose a standard resource type. Steal up to 2 units of that resource from EACH OTHER player.

Staged Protests.name: Staged Protests
Staged Protests.description: Requires 1 corruption. Gain 1 corruption. Until the end of this generation, milestones and awards cost +8 M€.

Plant Tax.name: Plant Tax
Plant Tax.description: ALL players lose 2 plants. Players can block this with corruption. Gain 1 corruption.

Infrastructure Overload.name: Infrastructure Overload
Infrastructure Overload.description: Gain 1 corruption. Reduce any energy production 2 steps.

Crater Survey.name: Crater Survey
Crater Survey.description: Identify 4 underground resources. Claim one of them.

Induced Tremor.name: Induced Tremor
Induced Tremor.description: Discard 1 underground resource from the board. Then excavate an underground resource.

Underground Habitat.name: Underground Habitat
Underground Habitat.description: Excavate an underground resource. Increase your plant production 1 step. Add 1 animal on another card.

Volunteer Mining Initiative.name: Volunteer Mining Initiative
Volunteer Mining Initiative.description: Excavate 1 underground resource for every 3 cities in play.

Nanofoundry.name: Nanofoundry
Nanofoundry.description: Requires 2 science tags. Reduce your energy production 5 steps. Draw 1 card for every power tag you have, including this.

Public Spaceline.name: Public Spaceline
Public Spaceline.description: Requires 5 space tags. This card has 2 Earth tags, 2 Jovian tags, 2 Venus tags, and 2 Mars tags.

Cut-throat Budgeting.name: Cut-throat Budgeting
Cut-throat Budgeting.description: Requires 1 corruption. Increase your M€, steel, and energy production 1 step each.

Canyon Survey.name: Canyon Survey
Canyon Survey.description: Identify 3 underground resources. Claim 1 of them.

Class-action Lawsuit.name: Class-action Lawsuit
Class-action Lawsuit.description: The player with more corruption than anybody else discards corruption until they have the same amount as the 2nd highest player, along with 3 M€ per unit of corruption removed this way.

Mercenary Squad.name: Mercenary Squad
Mercenary Squad.description: Requires 1 corruption. Remove up to 2 resources from ANY card

Research & Development Hub.name: Research & Development Hub
Research & Development Hub.description: 1 VP for every 3 data resources on this card.

Media Frenzy.name: Media Frenzy
Media Frenzy.description: Remove up to 1 corruption from another player. Reveal 2 cards from the deck until you reveal 2 event cards. Take them into hand and discard the rest.

Investigative Journalism.name: Investigative Journalism
Investigative Journalism.description: Decrease your M€ production 1 step. 1 VP per journalism resource on this card.

Whales.name: Whales
Whales.description: Requires 6 oceans. 1 VP for each animal on this card.

Guerilla Ecologists.name: Guerilla Ecologists
Guerilla Ecologists.description: Requires 1 corruption. Spend 4 plants to place a greenery tile IGNORING ADJACENCY RESTRICTIONS.

Thiolava Vents.name: Thiolava Vents
Thiolava Vents.description: Requires an ocean. Increase your heat production 2 steps. 1 VP per 3 microbes on this card.

Racketeering.name: Racketeering
Racketeering.description: Requires 1 corruption. Increase your M€ production one step for each crime tag you have INCLUDING EVENTS and this card.

Gas Trust.name: Gas Trust
Gas Trust.description: Gain 1 corruption. Gain 3 heat for each crime tag you have INCLUDING EVENTS and this card.

Family Connections.name: Family Connections
Family Connections.description: Gain 1 corruption for every city tag you have.

Biobatteries.name: Biobatteries
Biobatteries.description: Increase your energy production 1 step. Gain 1 energy for every microbe tag you have (including this.) For every power tag you have (including this) put 1 microbe on another card.

Export Convoy.name: Export Convoy
Export Convoy.description: Pay 4 plants, or 3 microbes, or 2 animals from any of your cards. Gain 20 M€ and 1 corruption.

Acidizing.name: Acidizing
Acidizing.description: Raise Venus 1 step. Excavate an underground resource.

Hackers:u.name: Hackers:u
Hackers:u.description: Requires 2 corruption. Decrease any M€ production 2 steps. Increase your M€ production 1 step for every unit of corruption you have.

Hired Raiders:u.name: Hired Raiders:u
Hired Raiders:u.description: Steal up to 4 M€, plus 1 extra M€ for each corruption resource you have, from any player.

Hadesphere.name: Hadesphere
Hadesphere.description: You start with 40 M€ and 5 steel. As your first action, identify any 3 underground resources on Mars.

Demetron Labs.name: Demetron Labs
Demetron Labs.description: You start with 45 M€ and 2 data on this card.

Jenson-Boyle & Co.name: Jenson-Boyle & Co
Jenson-Boyle & Co.description: You start with 46 M€ and 2 corruption.

Henkei Genetics.name: Henkei Genetics
Henkei Genetics.description: You start with 47 M€ and 1 corruption. As your first action, draw 2 microbe cards. 1 VP per 3 microbes on this card.

Arborist Collective.name: Arborist Collective
Arborist Collective.description: You start with 40 M€, 2 plants and 2 plant production.

Kingdom of Tauraro.name: Kingdom of Tauraro
Kingdom of Tauraro.description: You start with 50 M€ and 6 M€ production. All opponents gain 2 M€ production. As your first action, place a city.

Aeron Genomics.name: Aeron Genomics
Aeron Genomics.description: You start with 35 M€, 5 steel, and 2 animals on this card. 1 VP per 3 animals on this card.

Keplertec.name: Keplertec
Keplertec.description: You start with 33 M€, 3 titanium, and 1 titanium production.

Voltagon.name: Voltagon
Voltagon.description: You start with 38 M€ and 1 energy production.

Anubis Securities.name: Anubis Securities
Anubis Securities.description: You start with 42 M€. As your first action, play a card ignoring global requirements.

Hecate Speditions.name: Hecate Speditions
Hecate Speditions.description: You start with 38 M€, 2 supply chain resources here, and an extra trade fleet.

Investor Plaza.name: Investor Plaza
Investor Plaza.description: Place a city and gain 1 corruption.

Inherited Fortune.name: Inherited Fortune
Inherited Fortune.description: Gain 1 corruption and 10 M€. Increase your M€ production 1 step.

Tunneling Operation.name: Tunneling Operation
Tunneling Operation.description: Identify 1 underground resource. Then excavate 2 underground resources. Increase your steel production 2 steps.

Geological Expertise.name: Geological Expertise
Geological Expertise.description: Identify 4 underground resources. Claim one of them. Draw 2 cards with science tags.

Underground Settlement.name: Underground Settlement
Underground Settlement.description: Place a city. Then identify the underground resources in all adjacent spaces. Claim 1 of them.

Ganymede Trading Company.name: Ganymede Trading Company
Ganymede Trading Company.description: Gain 1 corruption, 3 titanium, and a trade fleet.

Central Reservoir.name: Central Reservoir
Central Reservoir.description: Place an ocean ON AN AREA NOT RESERVED FOR OCEAN. Then identify the underground resources in all adjacent spaces. Claim 2 of them.

Battery Shipment.name: Battery Shipment
Battery Shipment.description: Gain 12 energy. Increase your energy production 2 steps.

Deepwater Dome.name: Deepwater Dome
Deepwater Dome.description: Increase your plant production 1 step. Place an ocean.

Prospecting.name: Prospecting
Prospecting.description: Pay 4 M€. Put an additional colony tile of your choice into play. Then place a colony on it.
